say: In this town... when it rains, it rains MONEY!
text: IN THIS TOWN... WHEN IT RAINS, IT RAINS MONEY!

say: His bucket had a hole in it. So he made a plan.
text: HIS BUCKET HAD A HOLE IN IT. SO HE MADE A PLAN.

say: But the rich kid had a bigger plan.
text: BUT THE RICH KID HAD A BIGGER PLAN.

say: Then the clouds rolled in... the biggest money storm ever!
text: THEN THE CLOUDS ROLLED IN... THE BIGGEST MONEY STORM EVER!

say: But the vacuum got... way too full.
text: BUT THE VACUUM GOT... WAY TOO FULL.

say: All the money fell into his bucket... and right through the hole.
text: ALL THE MONEY FELL INTO HIS BUCKET... AND RIGHT THROUGH THE HOLE.

say: But the hole wasn't a mistake. It was a pipe, straight to his secret vault!
text: BUT THE HOLE WASN'T A MISTAKE. IT WAS A PIPE, STRAIGHT TO HIS SECRET VAULT!

say: Now he's the richest guy in town.
text: NOW HE'S THE RICHEST GUY IN TOWN.
